computation.result: 38uA*4700ohm*1.001=0.178779V; reconstruction factors27.2765957 and32.2765957. Bench leakage/ramp test remains open.

findings.summary: Fresh-ARM DFF blocks the known stationary-ARM/HEART analog-rail-recovery pulse for valid logic supplies.
findings.description: U8 D=carrier3V3, CLK=ARM, CLRn=CODEC_RESET, Q=HC123clear. Firmware active shutdown also assertsRESET because ARM falling alone no longer clears this latch.

computation.description: Compare HC123clear-release behavior using the old AND and new DFF state tables.
computation.result: Legacy model triggers RUN on recovery with ARM/HEART stuckHIGH; new latch stays clear until a fresh ARM edge. Analog brownout timing is not certified.
